cohort: The study included 2,235,012 singleton persons born in Sweden between 1973 and 1995, 48.6% of whom were women.
finding: Preterm birth was associated with an increased risk of lipid disorders in early- to midadulthood, with a dose-response relationship where lower gestational age correlated with higher risk.
gest_age: From 22 weeks to 41 weeks (categorized as extremely preterm 22-27 weeks, very preterm 28-33 weeks, late preterm 34-36 weeks, and full-term 39-41 weeks)
